text:
Alex G: handing off to @Maria P and @Leo — quick summary of today

Alex G: incident INC-2026-0456 — embed-service returned 503s across eu-west between 09:12-09:46 UTC, spike correlated with a new client batch job. paged at 09:13. :rotating_light:
incidents-bot: Pager triggered for service=embed-service severity=high route=eu-west pg=PD-3491 at 09:13
Maria P: on it earlier, autoscaler didn't spin extra pods fast enough. increase in concurrent bulk-embed jobs + cold KV cache causing CPU rise on a subset of nodes.
Sanjeev: saw CPU p95 jump to ~88% on embed-workers-2a, heap growth from batching. logs showed repeated OOM attempts then 503s.
Leo: what mitigations did we run?
Maria P: immediate actions: 1) scaled replica count from 6->12, 2) disabled batch-job from the offending client (via admin API), 3) enabled temporary routing to fallback-quant model in us-west for eu requests (soft-failover). Latency P95 normalized by 09:40.
Alex G: customer impact: handful of users on EU region saw failures and retries; we estimate ~120 failed requests and 3 customers surfaced support tickets. no data loss.
Tara: opened support ticket SUP-1129 and notified account team.
Sanjeev: root cause hypothesis: batch job with parallelism 40 hit the service during cache-cold window. autoscaler timeline: took ~6m to add pods due to slow node provisioning in eu-west spot pool.
Leo: any config changes we should keep?
Maria P: short-term: pin autoscaler minReplicas to 8 for eu-west, enable node warm pool for spot nodes, and add a request-rate based trigger in scaler. long-term: add backpressure/shed for bulk client jobs or enforce queueing in client contract.
Alex G: runbook link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/98765-embed-service-pager — follow section "Bulk-job mitigation". also see playbook snippet below for disabling a client job quickly:
```bash
# disable client job via admin API
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  https://admin.redwood.internal/clients/12345/actions/disable
```
Maria P: open action items (short):
- increase eu-west autoscaler minReplicas to 8 (Sanjeev)
- add admission check for big batch jobs (Tara)
- update incident postmortem template with node-warm-pool note (Alex G)
- follow up with infra on spot provisioning lag (Leo)

Sanjeev: I already put a tentative PR for minReplicas -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/512 (wip)
deploy-bot: Deployment infra/warm-pool-provisioner queued at 10:05 UTC (PR 512)
Maria P: coverage: primary for next 12h = Maria P (EU), secondary = Leo (global). after 21:00 UTC coverage reduces to on-call rotation (gap flagged) — @ops-lead we need someone for 00:00-04:00 UTC tomorrow (travel conflict).
Alex G: noted. if no volunteer, schedule handover to night oncall and leave clear runbook steps.
Leo: tagging follow-ups in the handoff doc. running checklist summary:
- current status: embed-service stable, fallback routing disabled at 10:10 UTC, autoscaler minReplicas adjusted on staging, prod change pending PR merge.
- customer impact: low now, a few support tickets open, account teams notified.
- next steps: complete PR, monitor eu-west p95 and 5xx for next 24h, add rule to alert if p95>500ms for more than 5m.
Tara: leaving runbook pointers in the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-0456 and ops checklist link https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/23456-Oncall+Checklist
Alex G: handoff complete. primary/secondary and action owners listed above. ping here for any escalation. :thumbsup:
Leo: thanks — will watch the dashboards until PR merges.
incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-0456 status=monitoring assigned_to=Maria P
Maria P: adding retrospective note: consider throttling client-side bulk endpoints by default to protect embeddings throughput.
Alex G: ok, signed off. leaving notes for night oncall.
